factual_claims.claim: Total operating cash flows surged to EUR 388,632 thousand for the twelve months of 2025 from EUR 89,288 thousand, supported by disciplined inventory management, full-year consolidation adjustments, and stable operational performance.

factual_claims.claim: Segment developments highlighted mixed operational trends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: In maritime transport, Tallink Grupp carried 5,531,132 passengers, a 0.9% decrease year-on-year, recording annual revenue of EUR 765.3 million and net profit of EUR 17.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report - Maritime Transport section (I4) states: 'In the financial year 2025... Tallink carried 5,531,132 passengers, representing a 0.9% decrease year-on-year. Unaudited consolidated revenue amounted to EUR 765.3 million... unaudited net profit for the period was EUR 17.3 million.'

factual_claims.claim: In the energy sector, Elenger Grupp increased its fourth-quarter gas and electricity sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh despite a regional consumption decline.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 - Energy business segment (I9) states: 'Elenger Grupp gas and electricity sales volumes in the fourth quarter increased by 7% compared to a year earlier, totalling 4.8 TWh (compared to 4.5 TWh in Q4 2024).' The text also notes 'natural gas consumption in the Finnish-Baltic region totalled 11.5 TWh, decreasing by 2% compared with the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: Infortar also continued strategic portfolio diversification into agriculture through Infortar Agro, including the fourth-quarter acquisition of Oisu Biogaas, alongside real estate and infrastructure projects such as the Rail Baltica mainline construction.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 - Changes in Infortar's areas of activity (I10) states: 'In November, Infortar announced the acquisition of a 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas.' INF Infra section (I10) states: 'INF Infra... continued the construction of Rail Baltica's mainline on the Kangru-Saku section.' Supporting Sectors section (I5) details agriculture expansion via Infortar Agro.

factual_claims.claim: Overall performance demonstrated increased group resilience and stable cash generation amid an uneven macroeconomic environment.

Strong liquidity and prudent leverage give us the freedom to make decisions with a long-term perspective.' Cash Flow Statement (I18-I19) shows strong operating cash flow increase to 388,632 thousand.
